decision: Select the artistic brief for the first V1.1 content experiment. This selection must not alter the accepted route.

proposals.label: Découverte historique vivante
proposals.visit_intent: Give a first-time visitor a lively, accessible understanding of how Bordeaux was shaped by the river, commerce, power and architecture.
proposals.why_discriminating: Closest to V1, but makes depth and optional extensions explicit. Lowest artistic discontinuity.

proposals.label: Pouvoirs, arts et architecture
proposals.visit_intent: Read Bordeaux through the institutions, symbols, architecture and artistic choices by which the city represented power across centuries.
proposals.why_discriminating: More cultural and interpretive; gives buildings multiple readings without turning the base route into a specialist tour.

proposals.label: Bordeaux vivant, hier et aujourd’hui
proposals.visit_intent: Connect historical transformation with the contemporary city so each stop explains both what happened here and what remains visible or alive today.
proposals.why_discriminating: Strongest present-day bridge and the only option that may justify selective immersive sound after explicit artistic review.
